title: French Garlic Crumble Tart
description: A French-inspired tart that combines the flavors of garlic and crumble. This is a simple and delicious dish that's perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: Peruvian Crumble (or substitute with other type of crumble)

instructions: Roll out a sheet of puff pastry and place it on a baking sheet.
Spread a layer of fried garlic oil on the pastry.
Mix the crumble and peruvian crumble together and sprinkle it on top of the pastry.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
